messages:
maria_support: FYI customer reported credits hit 0 ~05:12 UTC during a large embed batch right before the monthly refill (expected ~06:00 UTC). They ran continuous retries and saw 429s. Ticket #38421. Attaching short repro they ran.

liam_engineer: Can you paste the request ids / sample headers? Need to see X-RateLimit and any Retry-After. Also which SDK and whether they used streaming or batch embed endpoint.

maria_support: Here are two request IDs from the customer's logs: r-06a2f9, r-06a2fb. They used SDK v2 bulk embed with batch_size=256 and a custom retry loop (no jitter). Example snippet they shared: 
```
for chunk in chunks(items, 256):
  resp = client.embeddings.create(model="open-embed-001", input=chunk)
  if resp.status == 429:
    retry()  # basic immediate retry, no backoff
```

jon_sre: :eyes: immediate retries + large batches at month boundary = prime candidate for exhausting the bucket quickly. Also ask if the org has a staggered billing window or a custom timezone. If refill was queued at 06:00 but edge cache still had 0, visible UI/API could show zero for several minutes.

maria_support: Customer timezone = America/Denver. They expect refill at local midnight but confirmed they rely on our monthly-window aligned to UTC 06:00. They said UI showed refill at 06:02 but API still returned 429 until ~06:06.

liam_engineer: That matches an edge cache propagation gap. We recently delayed the refill publish in billing-window to avoid thundering herd, which can leave edge caches stale for up to 3-5 minutes under load. Combine that with immediate retries and you get a quick drain, then visible zero even after backend refill.

maria_support: Customer repro notes: they ran a load test that bursts 10 concurrent workers, each pushing batch_size 256 with a tight retry loop for 8 minutes. They say tokens dropped to 0 at 05:59:40 and refill visible at 06:02:10, API 429 until 06:06:18.

jon_sre: Two action items: 1) Devs — verify billing-window publishes a refill event immediately and that quota-sync consumers prioritize edge invalidation. 2) Support — advise customer to implement exponential backoff + respect Retry-After headers.

liam_engineer: I pulled the billing logs for that window. Refill job executed at 06:00:05 UTC and updated central store at 06:00:06. Refill event queued to kafka topic "quota-refill" at 06:00:07 but under high load the quota-sync worker backlog pushed the edge invalidation to ~06:02:05. Edgebot shows a 115s delay.

edgebot: [automated] quota-refill event rcvd: id=refill-2023-06-01-06:00:07, central_store_update=06:00:06, edge_invalidation_completed=06:02:01.

liam_engineer: Root cause: edge invalidation lag during heavy backpressure + customer immediate-retry pattern. That allowed retries to continue draining tokens even after central refill. Not a double-charge in accounting, but the observable zero window was prolonged.

maria_support: Customer asked for mitigation they can apply immediately. Suggested message drafted: "Please implement exponential backoff with randomized jitter and honor Retry-After. For bulk embed workloads, reduce batch_size to 64-128 and add client-side rate limiting. If you need deterministic capacity during rollovers, consider Redwood Dedicated or schedule bulk jobs away from reset windows."

jon_sre: Addendum — also recommend idempotency keys for long-running jobs so retries don't cause duplicate upstream work where applicable. For embeddings it's tricky but helpful if you dedupe at the caller.

liam_engineer: I'll open an internal task to shorten edge invalidation latency during refill events and to instrument quota-sync backlog alerts. Ticket: INF-4721.

maria_support: Customer was satisfied with guidance. They'll re-run with backoff + smaller batches and report back. Closing our loop but keeping INF-4721 open for follow-up. :thumbsup:

liam_engineer: Notes for postmortem: include sample repro steps (attached) and a small script we used to reproduce: 
```
# repro script (python)
for i in range(10):
  spawn_concurrent_workers(10, target_batch=256, tight_retry=True)
  sleep(1)
```
We should test with a staging refill and measure edge lag.

jon_sre: Agreed. Also add a small UI note in support KB: "If you see 429 around refill window, check Retry-After and reduce burst size."

maria_support: Will update KB and close thread after a follow-up run.
